The structure of SrBi₂O₆ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms (Sr₆Bi₁₂O₂₄) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers coordinated by six O neighbors (about 2.05–2.06 Å), while Sr centers exhibit an eight-vertex coordination polyhedron with two Bi and six O neighbors, and O centers show tetrahedral coordination by four Bi atoms. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between O tetrahedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Sr polyhedra.
